description: Turn embedded graphics back into links (Einbettung aufheben): without folder_path InDesign links to the original file again (fails when it is gone), with folder_path the file is written to that folder and linked from there. Returns unembedded[] with the new file_path and status, skipped[] (not embedded), links_after.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

folder_path.description: Existing folder to write the files into.

frame_id.description: All linked graphics of this object. Pass either link_ids or frame_id.

link_ids.description: Links from list_links. Pass either link_ids or frame_id.

name: unembed_link
title: Unembed links
